import sqlite3, json
src='/app/main.db'
out='/app/recovered.json'
con=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{src}?mode=ro', uri=True)
rows=con.execute('SELECT id, name, value FROM inventory ORDER BY id').fetchall()
if any(type(i) is not int or not isinstance(n,str) or type(v) is not int for i,n,v in rows):
    raise TypeError('Unexpected record types')
with open(out,'w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump([{'id':i,'name':n,'value':v} for i,n,v in rows], f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    f.write('\n')
print(f'Wrote {len(rows)} base-snapshot records to {out}')
